about_the_game:
In this demo you can play the first 30 minutes of the game: The Left Behind. The demo features a handcrafted post-apocalyptic world. Explore a typical Dutch open-world landscape at daytime and beware of hordes of enemies coming in at night. Loot and hunt to survive. Each night, the game becomes increasingly challenging. Keep track of your highscore and try to survive as many nights as possible and/or play through an immersive and mysterious story!

The world

Explore a typical Dutch landscapes in a post apocalyptic setting. Every building you encounter can be entered and looted. Discover the personality of each building, the world and the people that used to live in it.

Objectives

Survive solo as long as you can in this harsh world. Loot abandoned buildings at daylight and try to survive enemies coming in at night. Keep an eye out for your food, thirst and health bar at all times. Stack up some food while you can, you never know when you need it…

Features

- Shoot, loot and survive your way through this open world.

- Unlock new areas and weapons while playing the game.

- Encounter various enemies and animals in the world.

- Explore an unique section of the world.

- Unlock various melee and ranged weapons.

- Immerse yourself in the first 30 minutes of a mysterious story.

The full game will feature

- The complete story.

- Steam achievements.

- A solo mode and a co-op mode where you can play the game with up to four (4) players.

- The complete map.

- More buildings to explore.

- An epic boss battle.

- And more!

How many nights can you survive?

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Contains violence and gore. General Mature Content.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I5-8400 or AMD RYZEN 3 3300X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB or AMD Radeon RX 570 4GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD is highly recommended or expect longer than average load times.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
